title: EgoCPT: Learning Dexterous Manipulation from a Single Ego-Centric Video with Contact-Aware Optimization
authors: Zhixin Sun, Kairui Shi, Tianao Ren, Ming Yang, Mark Cutkosky, James Jingxi Xu

tldr.zh: EgoCPT 从单段第一视角视频及参考手部轨迹恢复物体运动，通过接触采样、手部姿态优化与受力分配寻找机器人可行的双手交互，再用 PPO 残差策略修正执行，生成可用于真机回放的操作轨迹。
tldr.en: EgoCPT recovers object motion from a single egocentric video and reference hand trajectories, searches robot-feasible bimanual interactions through contact sampling, hand-pose optimization and force allocation, then uses PPO residual control to refine execution and generate manipulation trajectories for real-robot replay.

evaluation_scope.zh: 输入为 RGB 视频＋带尺度的三维手部参考轨迹；固定示范物体运动，以人手运动为空间先验，搜索符合关节、碰撞、摩擦及执行器限制的机器人接触与受力。PPO 在仿真中根据物体位姿、参考目标及机器人状态输出 56 维双手残差（腕部平移 6＋旋转 6＋手指关节 44），叠加参考动作；优化得到的接触力用于可行性判断与奖励引导，不直接作为策略力矩指令。实验使用 Sharpa 手：五类任务的 52 条 EgoDex 重建序列和 25 条 TACO 序列，成功率分别为 67.3%／92.0%，是真机回放前的仿真轨迹跟踪评测；真机展示为双手轨迹回放，未验证在线闭环部署。当前假设刚体物体，EgoDex 评测排除了物体位姿重建错误的输入。
evaluation_scope.en: Inputs are RGB video and metric 3D reference hand trajectories. Object motion is fixed while human motion guides robot contact/force search under joint, collision, friction and actuator limits. In simulation, PPO outputs 56 bimanual residuals (6 wrist translations + 6 rotations + 44 finger joints) added to reference motions; optimized forces guide feasibility checks and rewards rather than direct policy torque commands. Sharpa-hand evaluations cover five task families: 52 EgoDex and 25 TACO sequences achieve 67.3% and 92.0% simulated trajectory-tracking success. Hardware demonstrates bimanual trajectory replay, not online closed-loop policy deployment. The method assumes rigid objects; EgoDex inputs with incorrect reconstructed object poses are excluded.
